reason: A named independent lab and a batch report I can check against the box is exactly what I look for, and bisglycinate with no oxide at a stated 200 mg is the form I would pick. The sachets are handy for my work trips, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy price to try.
objection: It is a brand new product with no reviews yet, so I would want to open the lab report and see that the lab is real and the batch number matches. Two capsules a day is also a bit of a chore, and I will only reorder if I notice it helps my sleep.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open or the batch number did not match the box, I would not buy.
